description: S48 T10 (BP9): the agent door for blueprints — blueprint.propose creates an INERT proposal row of kind blueprint_save (nothing is added or changed until a person commits it at the socket's human door; the five blueprint write doors stay the person's). The request carries no actor, createdBy, proposedBy, status, kind, state, origin or rev member (identity is stamped by the records service; the source is the WHOLE candidate, never a patch, so a smuggled mode meets the service's strict decode). The answer is the stored row with THE copyable commit command and the fixed inertness note — the same PolicyProposeResult the policy and autonomy twins answer with: one machinery, one sentence.
